shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status -sb; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts; cat src/orchestration/onErrorValues.test.ts; cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "cat package.json; cat scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; rg -n 'onError|spec:' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; cat jest.config.js"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'validated by:.*validated by:' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs | head; rg -n 'trailing parenthetical|validated by' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs | head -30; sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts; sed -n '1,100p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/orchestration/onErrorValues.test.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"import type {AIProvider, MessageChunk} from '../types/ai.js';\", \"import type {AIProvider} from '../types/ai.js';\")
a=s.index('    const provider: AIProvider = {')
b=s.index('    const session:',a)
s=s[:a]+\"    const provider = {} as AIProvider;\\n\"+s[b:]
s=s.replace(\"hooks: {onError: async (_session, error) => void seen.push(error)},\", \"hooks: {\\n        beforeSession: async () => {\\n          throw reason;\\n        },\\n        onError: async (_session, error) => void seen.push(error),\\n      },\")
a=s.index('    expect(outcome.rejected)')
b=s.index('\\n  }',a)
s=s[:a]+'''    expect({
      rejected: outcome.rejected,
      sameReason: outcome.reason === reason,
      count: seen.length,
      isError: seen[0] instanceof Error,
      sameCause: seen[0]?.cause === reason,
    }).toEqual({rejected: true, sameReason: true, count: 1, isError: true, sameCause: true});'''+s[b:]
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md')
s=p.read_text().replace(')) ([validated by:', '), [validated by:')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorValues.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check; git diff; git status -sb; nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts | head -10; nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorValues.test.ts | head -10; nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '50,66p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/onErrorValues.test.ts && git commit -m 'Fix hook test traceability and assertions' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
